items.headline: Why do Venus and Jupiter meet up in the sky so often? It's a symptom of a solar system that supports life on Earth
items.teaser: As it turns out, the conditions that set Venus and Jupiter up for their conjunctions in the sky are the same that are critical for life to survive on Earth.
